a.lede: The central, still-unproven claim in the Nvidia scandal is that Alice Huang, the former Megaspeed exec with whom Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had an extramarital affair, is a Chinese spy.
a.title: Is Alice Huang a spy or not?

b.lede: Jensen Huang says he didn't get special treatment from the government at first Nvidia all-hands meeting since his return — "there are rumors on the internet that apparently I’m a tech bro, and therefore I’m back"
b.title: Jensen Huang denies special government treatment at first Nvidia all-hands since return
